title: Russia delivers fighter jets to Ethiopia
description: Ethiopian officials confirmed that Russia delivered 12 fighter jets and plans to send air defense systems, increasing fears of renewed conflict in the region.

title: Ukrainian drone attack on Russian oil refineries
description: Ukraine launched a drone attack on Russian oil refineries, targeting key infrastructure.

title: Saudi-led coalition strikes Yemen
description: The Saudi-led coalition fighting Yemen’s Houthis says its forces destroyed a ballistic missile platform in Saada, Yemen

title: Ships on fire in Hormuz
description: Iran claims three ships hit mines in the Strait of Hormuz

title: ICJ Genocide Ruling
description: The International Court of Justice rules that Myanmar committed genocide against the Rohingya

title: North Korea expands uranium enrichment facility
description: North Korea is expanding a nuclear facility for enriching uranium, according to the UN nuclear watchdog

title: Israeli strike on residential building
description: Airstrike on a residential building in Gaza killed at least eight people (BBC) and reportedly up to 13 (France 24).

title: Iranian drone attack on US base in Bahrain
description: Iran launched drones against a U.S. military installation in Bahrain, the third such strike in recent days.

title: Russian air defenses intercept Ukrainian drones
description: Russian air defenses intercepted 1,336 Ukrainian drones in a major attack

title: Iran attacks U.S. base in Kuwait and radar in Bahrain
description: Iran fired on a U.S. air base in Kuwait and launched drone attacks on a radar facility in Bahrain, widening the conflict.

title: SAF airstrike in West Kordofan
description: Sudanese army airstrike in Abu Qalb area kills at least 13 civilians, including women and children.

title: Indian forces kill LeT commander Mohammad Lateef Bhat, rescue 27 civilians
description: Indian troops eliminated LeT commander Mohammad Lateef Bhat in Kulgam. Security forces rescued 25 girls and two teachers from a nearby Darul Uloom institute just before the final assault that killed him.

title: Western allies clash over deep strikes
description: US representative Elbridge Colby criticized Kyiv's use of deep strikes against Russian targets, but Germany's defense minister said the US's criticism was misguided.

title: Trump-Xi-Putin Trilateral Meeting
description: US President Trump, Chinese President Xi, and Russian President Putin held their first-ever joint talks in Shenzhen, focusing on nuclear arms control and resolving the wars in Ukraine and Iran.

title: Russian Strike on Odesa
description: Russia repeatedly struck central Odesa, killing four people and injuring nine, according to Ukrainian officials who stated the enemy does not stop.

title: German FM visits South Caucasus
description: German Foreign Minister Wadephul visited Armenia and Azerbaijan to discuss the peace process and counter Russian influence.

title: Russian defense intercepts Ukrainian drones
description: Russian defenses intercepted numerous Ukrainian drones, highlighting the ongoing conflict.

title: US-Venezuela Military Partnership Announcement
description: US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth announced a new military partnership agreement with Venezuela.

title: Ethiopia-Eritrea border tensions escalate
description: Ethiopia and Eritrea amass forces along their border, heightening war fears

title: Ukraine drone attack on Russia
description: Ukraine struck a key bridge and targeted oil refineries in a major drone attack on Russia

title: Ukraine strikes Crimea Bridge and southern oil refinery
description: Ukraine launched a large drone attack hitting the Crimea Bridge and a key oil refinery in southern Russia, causing two deaths in Crimea.

title: Russian missile strike damages Kyiv Dnipro bridges
description: Russian ballistic missiles hit Kyiv’s northern and southern Dnipro bridges, damaging the subway system and partially cutting water and power supplies.

title: Iran warns of preemptive strike
description: Iran warns it may strike first before another US attack

title: Ukrainian drone strike hits Crimean (Kerch) Bridge
description: Ukraine launched a large overnight drone attack that struck the Kerch Bridge linking Russia to annexed Crimea.

title: Russian missiles hit two Kyiv bridges
description: Russia struck the Northern and Southern bridges in Kyiv, causing partial damage to water and power supplies.

title: Kherson localized cease‑fire ends
description: A six‑day cease‑fire in the Kherson region concluded, with no reported violations during the truce but renewed risk of fighting.

title: UN report on drone casualties
description: UN report says at least 1,390 civilians were killed Jan‑Jun 2026, over 80% from drone strikes.

title: Israeli forces kill six in Gaza
description: Israeli forces killed six people across the Gaza Strip, including a six-year-old boy.

title: U.S. strikes IRGC missile launch site on Qeshm Island
description: U.S. precision munitions hit an IRGC missile launch site on Qeshm Island, prompting Iranian retaliation.

title: South Korea scrambles fighter jets
description: After Russian military aircraft enter air defense zone

title: Chinese vessel rams Philippine ship
description: A Chinese vessel reportedly rammed a Philippine ship in the South China Sea, prompting Manila to accuse Beijing of harassment.

title: WHO IHR Emergency Committee meets on Ebola
description: The WHO Director-General addressed the third IHR Emergency Committee meeting regarding the Bundibugyo virus epidemic, highlighting insecurity as a major obstacle to the response.

title: IS militants killed near Chechnya
description: Russian forces killed eight IS militants near Chechnya who were part of the Caucases Emirates group.

title: Guinea jails 200 miners and administrators
description: Guinea sentenced 22 former regional administrators and 202 others for involvement in illegal gold mining, following a crackdown that detained over 1,200 miners in Siguiri.

title: Iran warns of preemptive strike against U.S.
description: Iran’s deputy foreign minister warned that Tehran will not wait for a U.S. attack, saying Washington is buying time to prepare for a strike. Iran also threatened retaliation against any U.S. aggression.

title: Ethiopia-Sudan mutual accusations
description: Ethiopia and Sudan accused each other of supporting armed groups waging war within their borders, undermining peace efforts and raising fears of a wider regional conflict.

title: Russian drone strike in Hlukhiv
description: A Russian drone struck a small house in the northern Ukrainian town of Hlukhiv, burying a nine-year-old boy and his grandmother under the debris.

title: Russian attack on Dnipro's train station
description: A Russian drone strike killed at least 14 people at Dnipro's train station.

title: Russian glide bomb attack on school
description: A Russian glide bomb attack killed at least 31 Ukrainians at a school distributing medicine and food in the Zaporizhzhia region.

title: Fujian aircraft carrier sails through Taiwan Strait
description: China's newest aircraft carrier, Fujian, sailed through the Taiwan Strait, prompting a response from Taiwan's defense ministry

title: Sudan‑Ethiopia diplomatic tensions
description: Sudan and Ethiopia exchange accusations of supporting armed groups within each other's borders.

title: RSF drone attacks on Sudan power stations
description: RSF drone strikes hit power stations in southeast Sudan, knocking out electricity and causing civilian casualties, leaving cities without power.

title: ASEAN summit discusses tough South China Sea code‑of‑conduct
description: At an ASEAN summit, leaders gathered as analysts warned that reaching a final South China Sea code of conduct will be a tall order amid heightened China‑Philippines tensions.

title: Iran launches second drone attack on Bahrain
description: Iran carried out a drone strike on Bahrain, marking the second such attack within days.

title: North Korea launches ICBM
description: North Korea launched an intercontinental ballistic missile, posing a grave threat to regional stability.

title: Israeli air strike kills senior Hamas commander
description: Israeli air strike kills senior Hamas commander in Gaza

title: Yemen repositions Red Sea troops
description: Yemen’s army announced it is repositioning troops from the Red Sea amid the ongoing regional conflict.

title: Zaporizhzhia infrastructure strikes
description: Russian attacks on Zaporizhzhia injured 22 people, including children, and forced the closure of the DniproHES dam.

title: South Korea probes soldier death
description: South Korean authorities are investigating the death of a frontline soldier near the North Korean border, an incident occurring amidst heightened tensions.

title: Thailand blocks fuel to Cambodia
description: Thailand moved to block fuel from reaching Cambodia as the border conflict continues to escalate, according to the Council on Foreign Relations.

title: Nagorno-Karabakh Fighting
description: Dozens killed in fighting between Armenia and Azerbaijan in Nagorno-Karabakh

title: Cambodia criticizes Thailand at Francophonie Summit
description: Prime Minister Hun Manet used his opening remarks at the Francophonie summit in Phnom Penh to criticize Thailand, stating that Cambodia did not start the 2025 border fighting.

title: US envoys meet Zelensky in Dublin
description: US envoy Steve Witkoff met President Zelensky in Dublin after talks with Putin in Moscow; Putin agreed to allow European negotiators to join the next round of Ukraine talks.

title: Russian hospital bombing injures 73
description: A Russian airstrike hit a Ukrainian hospital, injuring at least 73 people.

title: SAF successes in Kordofan
description: UN identified Kordofan as the conflict’s epicentre as SAF gains ground against RSF.

title: Iran views shift in US approach
description: After JD Vance ordered away

title: US floats Donbas cession for NATO
description: Ukraine claims the US suggested ceding parts of Donbas to Russia in exchange for NATO membership, a proposal that has sparked diplomatic tension.

title: IS-linked attack in Ituri
description: Gunmen linked to the Islamic State group killed at least 44 civilians in northeastern Ituri province.

title: North Korea tests cluster warhead
description: Pyongyang announced it tested a new cluster warhead for strategic cruise missiles, claiming it could destroy an area of 5 to 6 hectares with high-density power.

title: Accusations of drone-related ceasefire breach
description: Thailand accused Cambodia of breaking the ceasefire over an incident involving drones seen by both sides along the border line, hours after international praise for the 'hard-won' agreement.

title: Death of Hamas Rafah brigade commander
description: Hamas confirmed the death of Rafah brigade commander Samir Abu Younis in an Israeli strike on Khan Younis.

title: Myanmar airstrike on displacement camp
description: Airstrike kills 12 people, including a child, and wounds 18 others at a displacement camp in Rakhine state

title: ASEAN Summit condemns Myanmar violence
description: ASEAN leaders opened their annual summit in the Philippines, formally denouncing the violence in Myanmar and extending the ban on junta leader Min Aung Hlaing.

title: Gulf allies urge pause; IRGC hits radar
description: Saudi Arabia, Qatar and other Gulf states asked the U.S. to hold off large‑scale attacks; the IRGC retaliated by hitting a U.S. early‑warning radar in Bahrain.

title: Junta double‑tap airstrike on India Market in Kyauktaw, Rakhine
description: The Myanmar junta carried out double‑tap airstrikes on the India Market in Kyauktaw, Rakhine State, killing at least 50 people and wounding 58 civilians.

title: China conducts joint combat readiness patrol
description: Chinese fighter jets and drones carried out a joint combat readiness patrol alongside Chinese warships

title: Airstrike on Byar La displaced‑persons camp
description: Myanmar military airstrike on the Byar La camp in Rakhine State killed at least 12 civilians.

title: Tanker explosions in Strait of Hormuz
description: Iranian military claimed four oil tankers were hit by explosions in the Strait of Hormuz, attributing the incidents to naval mines after vessels ignored warnings.

title: Trump rejects need for Iran deal
description: President Trump stated that Washington no longer needed an agreement with Tehran, directing Vice President Vance to focus on domestic issues while considering diplomatic options.

title: Taiwan labels exercises as strike rehearsals
description: A senior Taiwanese security official told Reuters that recent Chinese military exercises were described as rehearsals for attacks on the island.

title: Israeli airstrike on Gaza’s Nasser Hospital kills six, wounds dozens
description: An Israeli airstrike hit Nasser Hospital in southern Gaza, killing at least six people, including a surgeon, and wounding dozens more. The strike was reported by multiple sources.

title: Xi Jinping declares Taiwan’s complete reunification inevitable
description: President Xi Jinping declared that Taiwan’s complete reunification with China is inevitable, reaffirming Beijing’s long‑term goal and noting the remark came a week before the APEC summit in Shenzhen, without explicitly mentioning the use of force.

title: Armed men kill civilians in Niger
description: At least 37 civilians were killed by armed men in western Niger

title: G7 condemns Chinese naval activity
description: G7 foreign ministers issued a statement declaring that China's actions east of Taiwan threaten regional stability and freedom of navigation.

title: Seoul summons Ukraine’s envoy over North Korean POW transfer
description: South Korea protested the secret handover of two captured North Korean soldiers, accusing Kyiv of destabilising the peninsula.

title: Hegseth impeachment proceedings
description: Impeachment articles accuse US Secretary of Defense Hegseth of committing an act of war by abducting Maduro without Congressional approval.

title: Soldiers sentenced to death
description: At least 66 Congolese soldiers were sentenced to death for cowardice and fleeing the frontline during rebel clashes.

title: Airstrike on Rakhine market
description: A military jet dropped two bombs on a market in rebel‑held Rakhine state, killing at least 50 people and injuring 58.

title: Trump meets Qatar mediator as US strikes Qeshm Island, Iran hits tankers
description: President Trump met Qatar’s mediator in Doha while the United States air‑struck Iran’s Qeshm Island, prompting Iranian forces to attack commercial tankers in the Gulf and Strait of Hormuz; officials said no immediate cease‑fire deal was forthcoming.

title: Chinese Forces Conduct Drills
description: China announced readiness patrols around Scarborough Shoal

title: South Korea tests hypersonic missile
description: South Korea tested its first domestically-developed hypersonic missile.

title: Reduced Chinese military activity near Taiwan
description: Taiwanese Ministry of National Defence reported only one Chinese aircraft north of Taiwan and eight ships near the island during the 24-hour period between November 8 and 9, a sharp drop from previous counts.

title: Mali PM visits Kouremale border
description: Mali's Prime Minister Major General Abdoulaye Maiga traveled to Kouremale on the border with Guinea to address the return of deported Malians, describing the situation as a humanitarian catastrophe.

title: IS‑linked militants burn vehicles and homes in Cantine, North Kivu
description: Militants affiliated with the Islamic State attacked Cantine in North Kivu, setting fire to vehicles and homes and causing extensive damage.

title: Russia and Ukraine exchange airstrikes
description: Renewed security talks described as productive

title: China deploys 100 ships and 49 aircraft around Taiwan
description: China sent a fleet of 100 warships and 49 aircraft to operate around Taiwan, according to Taiwan’s Ministry of National Defence.

title: Land‑mine explosions injure three South Korean soldiers
description: Explosions on the western edge of the DMZ wounded three troops, reigniting tensions over the 1953 armistice line.

title: South Korea and U.S. conclude joint “Hoguk” military exercises
description: The two‑week drill involved combined forces and multilateral “Keen Sword” exercises in Japan, underscoring allied readiness.

title: IS Sahel attacks
description: Suspected IS Sahel attacks left scores of civilians dead in Ménaka region

title: IS‑Sahel attacks civilian encampments in Ménaka
description: Armed assailants attacked civilian encampments in the Ménaka region, including Tinabow and Tagadayat, killing at least 48 civilians. The Idaksahak community attributed the attack to the Islamic State Sahel Province.

title: China warns against “provocative acts” after Philippine deployment
description: Beijing issued a warning, labeling the Philippine Coast Guard’s actions as provocative and reiterating its claim to the contested waters.

title: Philippine Coast Guard deploys largest vessel to challenge Chinese research ship near Batanes
description: The Philippine Coast Guard sent its biggest vessel, supported by aircraft, to confront a Chinese research vessel operating near the northern province of Batanes; the Chinese vessel subsequently withdrew.

title: Diplomats meet at the UN General Assembly sidelines
description: Iranian and US-aligned officials hold talks in New York, without a breakthrough on the frozen ceasefire.

title: Trump meets Rodríguez as Machado again fails to return
description: Their first face-to-face meeting since the raid coincides with Machado’s seventh set of failed attempts to re-enter Venezuela.

title: US envoys shuttle between Moscow and Kyiv
description: Witkoff and Kushner hold talks in both capitals; a brief pause ends with renewed strikes on Kyiv.

title: Hemedti sworn in to head a rival government in Nyala
description: RSF commander "Hemedti" is formally sworn in as head of the parallel "Tasis" administration, edging Sudan toward partition.

title: US announces deal for stake in Venezuela's oil reserves
description: President Donald Trump announced a deal giving the US a stake in Venezuela's oil reserves.

title: China fires water cannon at Philippine vessels
description: Chinese coast guard ships target Philippine boats near Scarborough Shoal for a second straight day.

title: Twin earthquakes strike Venezuela
description: A major double earthquake compounds the humanitarian crisis and becomes a political flashpoint during the transition.

title: Israel and Iran exchange fire again as ceasefire frays
description: A fresh round of direct strikes breaks out, drawing in US forces before another pause is announced.

title: Min Aung Hlaing elected president
description: Myanmar’s junta chief wins a parliamentary vote 429-126, formalizing military rule behind a civilian title.

title: Sudan’s army recaptures Khartoum
description: SAF forces retake the capital, consolidating control over central and eastern Sudan.

title: Mojtaba Khamenei named Iran’s new Supreme Leader
description: The Assembly of Experts names Khamenei’s son as his successor, the first hereditary transition in the Islamic Republic’s history.

title: US-Israeli strikes kill Iran’s Supreme Leader
description: A major air campaign, reported as "Operation Epic Fury," kills Ali Khamenei and other senior officials, triggering a wider war.

title: Ethiopia and Eritrea deploy troops to the border
description: Both countries move military equipment toward their shared border amid fears of renewed war.

title: North Korea’s first missile test of the year
description: The launch comes hours after the US raid on Maduro — a scenario North Korea’s leadership has long feared for itself.

title: US raid captures Maduro
description: US special forces seize Nicolás Maduro and his wife, flying them to the US to face narco-terrorism charges.

title: New ceasefire after the deadliest fighting in years
description: Three weeks of artillery, tank and drone warfare killed 100+ people before a fresh truce took hold.

title: Thailand launches new offensive and blocks fuel supplies
description: Thailand began a fresh military offensive, halted fuel shipments to Cambodia and, together with Cambodia’s closure of all border crossings, escalated the humanitarian crisis.

title: Thai offensive and fuel block
description: Thailand launched a new military offensive while Cambodia halted all border crossings. Thailand also moved to block fuel from reaching Cambodia as the conflict escalated.

title: Fighting enters fifth day and UN warns of civilian risk
description: Renewed combat near historic temples marked the fifth day of clashes, with the UN rights chief warning that strikes were moving further into each side’s territory and endangering civilians.

title: Renewed fighting
description: Fighting raged at the border of Cambodia and Thailand, with combat heard near centuries-old temples

title: Fighting enters 5th day
description: Renewed fighting raged at the border on December 11, with combat heard near temples. The Thai PM confirmed a phone call from US President Trump regarding the conflict.

title: Fighting reignites
description: Fighting reignited on the Cambodia-Thailand border

title: El-Fasher falls to the RSF
description: RSF forces capture El-Fasher after a long siege, consolidating control over Darfur.

title: Gaza ceasefire takes effect
description: A US-brokered ceasefire built around Trump’s 20-point plan begins, though violence continues intermittently.

title: JNIM declares a fuel blockade of Bamako
description: Al-Qaeda-linked militants begin systematically attacking fuel convoys headed for Mali’s capital.

title: U.S.-brokered summit
description: Leaders met in August 2025, issuing a joint peace declaration and initialing a peace agreement that envisages a transit corridor.

title: Armenia and Azerbaijan sign a peace framework
description: At the White House, both countries sign a preliminary deal including the US-run TRIPP transit corridor.

title: U.S.–brokered summit and joint peace declaration
description: Leaders of Armenia and Azerbaijan met in August 2025, issuing a joint peace declaration and initialing a peace agreement that outlines a transit corridor and steps toward normalising relations.

title: First ceasefire after a 5-day border clash
description: Malaysia-brokered truce ends five days of fighting that killed dozens and displaced hundreds of thousands.

title: Israel and Iran fight a direct 12-day war
description: Israel strikes Iranian nuclear and military sites; Iran retaliates with missile barrages before a ceasefire holds.

title: US-brokered ceasefire ends India-Pakistan fighting
description: After days of missile, drone and artillery exchanges, Trump announces a ceasefire; both sides confirm it hours later.

title: Attack on tourists in Pahalgam kills 26
description: A militant attack on Hindu tourists in Indian-administered Kashmir triggers the worst India-Pakistan crisis in decades.

title: M23 soldiers gather in Goma
description: M23 fighters were seen at the Stade de l’Unite’ in Goma for a public gathering.

title: Hamas attack on Israel starts the Gaza war
description: Hamas-led fighters attack southern Israel; Israel launches a sustained military campaign in Gaza in response.

title: Azerbaijan’s September 2023 offensive
description: Azerbaijan launched a large‑scale offensive that dissolved the Nagorno‑Karabakh enclave and displaced over 100,000 Armenians.

title: War erupts between SAF and RSF
description: Fighting breaks out in Khartoum between the army and the Rapid Support Forces, beginning Sudan’s civil war.

title: Russia launches full-scale invasion
description: Russian forces invade Ukraine on multiple fronts, beginning the largest war in Europe since 1945.

title: Ceasefire ending 2020 war
description: A Russia‑brokered ceasefire took effect in the early hours of 10 November 2020, ending the deadliest fighting.
